column1: # THE RENDERER -- aontu render (docs/design/RENDER.0.md; RENDER P3, the
# fragment fold). A document is evaluated, the value at `ask.at` (the
# root by default) is vetted against the bundled aontu:code vocabulary,
# and code.units is folded into bytes: one string per unit, the loss
# Columns: name<TAB>render<TAB>src<TAB>{"ask": {at?, profiles?, unit?, strict?}, "verdict", "units", "lossy"} -- or "errors" on error
# The options ride `expect.ask` as view's do: the same document renders
# differently under a caller-supplied profile, a unit filter, or strict.
# Newlines in a unit's text are written \n, which the runner's escape
# pass expands. Every expectation was obtained by running BOTH engines
# THE FOLD (D2, D3, D6). A bare string piece is a line at depth 0; a
# line is pad(at) + text + LF, and an empty text emits no pad; a blank
# is its terminators alone; a raw block's lines each get the pad unless
# reindent is false; nothing is trimmed. The unit is fragment-only, so
# it renders under aontu:render/lang/text, whose indent is two spaces.

column1: # THE DISPATCH TRACE AND THE COVERAGE REPORT (RENDER.0.md D11, P7).
# `ask.trace` records where every emitted piece came from; `ask.coverage`
# adds the report the trace and the read set together answer, and
# `ask.coverageAt` narrows the model it is measured over.
# A TRACE ENTRY NAMES THE NODE A RULE MATCHED AND THE RULE THAT MATCHED
# IT. The node is a READ address -- the path a reference resolved the
# selection at, and the node's key under it -- and the rule is its
# table's read address, then `#`, then its index in that table. A table
# written inline at the call site has no address of its own, so its
# rules are `#0`, `#1`; a table reached by name has one, `$.%wire#0`. A
# selection nothing read -- a computed bag -- leaves the node empty
# rather than naming a position inside a template instance, which is not
# in the document and which the two ports number differently.
# COVERAGE IS TWO SET COMPUTATIONS. Dead model is the SHALLOWEST paths
# no read reached: a subtree holding a read is descended into and its
# unread siblings named, a path read whole is not named at all, and the
# render's own `code` is output rather than model. A silent hole is a
# rendered declaration no stamp touches. The root of the measure is
# never itself dead: a document that is only a transform reads nothing
